summary: The quiet Stage A image is built, packaged and derived on the host. loader-diag-xnu-sq-md1 is NAT-092's image (decision 0036, run once by NAT-093, inconclusive: the returned log window was filled by Apple lsd[21]'s repeated CPU-monitor kernel message and the KL begin record was lost) with exactly one content change, the com.apple.lsd plist left out of the small root (md0), plus the image name (-sb- -> -sq-) and the command-line tag (NAT092-sb1 -> NAT096-sq1, same lengths). test_nat096.py compares the built payload with NAT-092's byte for byte (outside md0 only the two tag bytes differ; the loader differs only in the instruction immediates that encode the name) and the small root's tree with NAT-089's (the lsd plist is the only file missing). The driver equals its derivation from NAT-092's (9 counted substitutions); its registry gate adds NAT-096 and NAT-097. 40 tests pass; mutation: 107 killed, 3 survivors (examined, equivalent), 1 invalid candidate. Decision 0037 (every hash recomputed) is written for the one native run. Nothing here measures the phone.

findings: Only the lsd plist, the image name and the tag differ from NAT-092's image; the build took no change to NAT-087's or NAT-092's code (the wrapper is NAT-092's with the name, tag and the job table).

The mutation pass found the same three survivors as NAT-092's (sys.modules registration and two JSON indentation literals); reasons are attached from equivalent.json with the runner's --annotate mode after the pass.

Registration slip, disclosed: NAT-094 and NAT-095 were first registered with a dependency on NAT-093 (a run that ends inconclusive and so never completes); they cannot be claimed and stay pending, superseded by NAT-096 and NAT-097. The registry copy of NAT-096's acceptance text carries two wrong task IDs; docs/procedures/nat-096/task.json is the corrected text.
established: The built payload differs from NAT-092's only in the tag and in the loader's name immediates; the small root differs only by the lsd plist; hashes recorded above.
The driver equals its derivation; the packaged hashes are recorded in decision 0037.
not_established: That removing lsd empties the log window of the CPU-monitor message (another daemon may make the same request), that the delivery completes inside the cap, that the image boots, or that any Apple daemon but the heartbeat runs: a native run measures it.
That the loader's name-immediate bytes are exactly the name words: the test bounds them to the region and to 20 bytes; it does not decode the instructions.
